description: **Predict It* is a crypto-native prediction market game built around real, verifiable sports moments. Users wager on the outcome of pre-recorded penalty kicks before watching the video unfold. Payouts are dynamically calculated based on actual historical probabilities — just like Polymarket, but anchored to real-world sports footage instead of news events.
how_its_made:

I downloaded, edited and did the maths for the video and prediction market calculations.
